resume: PAUSED at stage 1 under the wave brief's two-candidate rule; no card written or registered, nothing cut, architecture 0. Read DESIGN_NOTE.md first and re-screen nothing in it. Two candidates on FC46's world, decision and quantity were prototyped and measured on three seeds and both fail the bar: candidate 1 (the cap priced on each member's predictive year with the spread of individual responses the pilot measures) and candidate 2 (membership orders are the cart's purchase sessions that paid-shipping orders batched). The structural finding: the right family is a continuum (the member's own rate uncertainty alone moves the capped total +1.26% to +1.54%, the response form +0.41% to +0.51%, pilot sampling about 0.6% one sigma), and under a per-member cap a common-factor error cancels the point-forecast error (point-capped average-uplift routes +1.77% to +3.06%), while a 52-week pilot would hand the golden over by filter and divide (-0.86%, SD 0.58%). No bin both holds the family inside a quarter-bin and puts every partial route a full bin away. Next pass: either keep the world and move the decisive step off the member's predictive year to a level neither the pilot nor the analog cohort hands over (price it on the harness against laws 1 and 2 first), or re-number to another seed in the lane (the author's call).
